properties.name: tenantkit.redis.enabled
properties.description: Master switch of the cache-redis module; false exits the module's auto-configuration entirely while user beans stay untouched.

properties.name: tenantkit.redis.key-prefix
properties.description: Whether tenantRedisTemplate rewrites keys to t:<tenant>:. false degrades the template to a transparent delegate: no rewriting, no stripping, no no-context policy (documented opt-out for shared-infrastructure jobs).

properties.name: tenantkit.redis.shared-keys
properties.description: Ant-style glob allow-list of keys that are never prefixed and never stripped (cross-tenant shared data, e.g. app:*). Shared keys are also the only keys reachable without a bound tenant while the policy is strict.

properties.name: tenantkit.redis.no-context-policy
properties.description: Behavior for non-shared key access with no tenant bound: strict throws TenantMissingException (TK-1001, fail-fast default); lenient passes the key through unprefixed and logs a warning. Startup cache-prefix computation is always lenient regardless of this value.

values.description: Throw TenantMissingException (TK-1001) on non-shared key access without a bound tenant.
Access the unprefixed key and log a warning; for scheduled/shared-infrastructure jobs.
